The '''Harda system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> as a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] region.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Hardan plague]],<ref name="Creatures">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Hardan plague]]|system=Harda [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> a [[Death/Legends|deadly]] disease that could be carried by [[Limb/Legends|winged]] [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] known as [[Bogan's brown nafen]].<ref name="Creatures" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Harda system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square S-7.<ref name="TEA" />
